description: A source filter selecting which columns are returned on each hit. Carried as the SearchQuery _source field. Only this typed {includes, excludes} form is accepted — the boolean (true / false) and bare-array shorthands are not.

includes.description: Optional. Columns to include. When empty or absent, all columns are included (subject to excludes).

excludes.description: Optional. Columns to exclude. Applied after includes.
